title: AlayaLab/HelloWorld
abstract:
Official repository for “HelloWorld: Enabling Socially Interactive Characters in Video World Models”. Huggingface: https://huggingface.co/papers/2608.05070

# HelloWorld: Enabling Socially Interactive Characters in Video World Models Liangyang Ouyang 1,2 , Ruicong Liu 2 , Xuangeng Chu 2 , Kaipeng Zhang 2 , Yoichi Sato 1 1 The University of Tokyo    2 Alaya Lab **HelloWorld** is a video world model that enables social interaction with in-world characters. With a single button press (`F`), users can prompt the on-screen character to respond toward the camera, *e.g.*, turning to the viewer, waving, nodding, or speaking a short greeting, while maintaining high-quality scene and camera-trajectory reconstruction. - **Self-distillation training:** the base video generation model is finetuned on data synthesized by itself, containing both social interactions and camera motion, so it learns camera-pose conditioning without degrading interaction quality. - **Training-free temporal control:** at inference, a temporal cross-attention mask localizes the character's response to the `F`-press window. - **HelloWorldBench:** a 400-sample benchmark with three social interaction metrics (ActAcc, TimeAcc, GazeDev) alongside three conventional metrics. ## Examples Warp Video Condition HelloWorld Generation A woman on a garden bench turns around and waves ("Hi") while the camera dollies in and orbits right: Two hikers turn and raise a thumbs-up ("Good!") while the camera rides a 30° orbit: A woman doing yoga presses her palms together and bows ("Namaste") during a left–right camera scan: Two anime figurines come alive, raise one hand and wave ("Hello!") as the camera orbits left and pushes in: A crow turns to the viewer, spreads its wings and caws while the camera orbits left: A bear mascot forms a heart with its arms during a right–left camera scan: A skeleton prop turns its skull and waves while the camera orbits left: ## Paper 📄 [HelloWorld.pdf](assets/HelloWorld.pdf) ## Demo Video [ ](https://youtu.be/j4scl5Y7gXo) ▶️ Watch on [YouTube](https://youtu.be/j4scl5Y7gXo)  ·  📥 Download: [HelloWorld.mp4](assets/HelloWorld.mp
abstract_zh: 本仓库为“HelloWorld：在视频世界模型中实现社交互动角色”的官方代码库。Huggingface: https://huggingface.co/papers/2608.05070。HelloWorld是一个视频世界模型，支持与场景内角色进行社交互动。用户只需按下“F”键，即可提示屏幕上的角色面向摄像头做出回应，例如转身、挥手、点头或说一句简短的问候，同时保持高质量的场景和相机轨迹重建。其核心方法包括：自蒸馏训练，基础视频生成模型在自身合成的包含社交互动和相机运动的数据上进行微调，从而在不降低互动质量的前提下学习相机姿态条件；免训练的时间控制，在推理时，通过时间交叉注意力掩码将角色的响应定位到“F”键按下的时间窗口；以及HelloWorldBench，一个包含400个样本的基准，包含三个社交互动指标（ActAcc、TimeAcc、GazeDev）和三个常规指标。
tldr_zh: HelloWorld让视频世界模型中的角色能响应按键互动，保持场景质量。
cover_zh: 按一下F键，视频里的角色居然会回头跟你打招呼？

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：通过自蒸馏训练让基础视频生成模型学习相机位姿条件与社交行为，推理时使用训练无关的时序交叉注意力掩码将角色响应定位到按键触发的时间窗口内。


# 一、动机

> 现有视频世界模型只能被动生成画面，无法支持用户与场景中的角色进行实时社交互动（如让角色转头、挥手、说话）。


# 二、方法

> 通过自蒸馏训练让基础视频生成模型学习相机位姿条件与社交行为，推理时使用训练无关的时序交叉注意力掩码将角色响应定位到按键触发的时间窗口内。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 构建了包含400个样本的HelloWorldBench基准，提出三个社交互动指标（ActAcc、TimeAcc、GazeDev）并搭配三个传统视频质量指标，实验表明该方法能在不降低场景和相机轨迹重建质量的前提下实现角色交互，具体数值详见论文。
